shared_tail.surface: أبي عبيدة بن محمد بن عمار

notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet after «بشر - المعنى -» (the «المعنى» is an editor's gloss): the names after the last «ح» are the shared tail (rule 3)
«قال قال زيد بن ثابت يغفر الله لرافع»: Zayd's own words close the chain (rule 6); Rafi' is named only in the scene
«زاد مسدد فسمع قوله» is a wording addition by one branch: left out
